qa_pair.question: In this Fortnox account, financial years are identified by a sequential ID rather than by calendar year. Which ID corresponds to the financial year covering 1 January 2024 to 31 December 2024? Answer with the numeric ID only.
What is the registered organisation number of the company connected to this Fortnox account? Answer in the format NNNNNN-NNNN.
Considering only invoices dated in calendar year 2024, which customer accounted for the highest total invoiced amount? Answer with that customer's customer number.
How many invoices are dated in calendar year 2024, counting every invoice regardless of payment status? Answer with the integer count.
Within calendar year 2024, which single month had the highest total invoiced amount? Answer in YYYY-MM format.

qa_pair.tools: fortnox_top_customers twice (2023 range, then 2024 range, metric=total_amount, top_n=3)
qa_pair.question: Rank customers by total invoiced amount separately for calendar year 2023 and for calendar year 2024. Which customer number appears in the top three of both years? If more than one does, answer with the lowest customer number.
Compare total invoiced amounts for calendar year 2023 against calendar year 2024. Which of the two years was higher? Answer with the four-digit year only.
How many accounts exist in this account plan within the revenue range 3000 to 3999 inclusive? Answer with the integer count.
How many of the voucher series configured in this account permit manual entries? Answer with the integer count.

First establish which financial-year ID covers calendar year 2024, then examine the vouchers recorded in that financial year. How many distinct voucher series appear among them? Answer with the integer count.
